Two volunteers offered Thursday availability, but no rota was established; two people must be present and the coordinator will seek regular partners.
A preliminary cutting list would record dates and visible headlines without unfolding fragile pages; it would not replace conservation or permit unrestricted use.
The coordinator will list publishable index fields, gather Thursday availability, and estimate listing time for June review.
No public launch date, purchases, or summer start for extra opening were promised.
